NCCOS at-sea seabird **density** models, Atlantic [@winship2018] + Pacific [@leirness2021], as
seasonal COGs (`n_per_km2`, 2-km, oblique-mercator). v11 rasterizes each (species × season × region)
onto the global 0.05° cell grid and maps the heavy-tailed density onto the merge's **[1,100]** scale
by the **population-percentile** transform (`msens::density_to_suit(method = "ud")`), plus an
**annual** surface for scoring.

- **Source COGs** (in-repo): `data/sdm/raw/nc_atl_birds_dens/*.tif` (140) + `nc_pac_birds_dens/*.tif`
  (135); band 1 = `n_per_km2` (bands 2/3 = CV/CI). Also public at
  `file.marinesensitivity.org/cog/sdm/raw/{ds}/{sp_code}_{season}.tif` (served natively via titiler).
- **`mdl_key`**: seasonal `nc|{sp_id}|{season}` + annual `nc|{sp_id}`. `sp_id` is `GBIF:…` for a
  species and `GUILD:{sp_code}` for the 13 multi-species guilds (these used to land under the
  genus/family GBIF id with `is_guild = FALSE`, and three of them shared an id with a real species).
  Regions (atl/pac) are spatially disjoint and **unioned** per `sp_id`.
- **Value transform (v11 Q6, D12).** Per model (species × season × region), AFTER regridding:
  `val = density_to_suit(d, "ud", area = cell area_km2)` — 100 minus the percent of the modelled
  population in cells strictly denser than this one, so the densest cell is 100 and the cells with
  `val >= 100 - p` are exactly the p % core. Cells with `val < 1` are dropped (the merge's floor). It is
  scale-free, which is why the Atlantic 2018 index and the Pacific densities are treated alike.
  The old recipe (`NC_TRANSFORM=cap`: linear to the species' pooled p99.5 of positive density, which left
  most cells near 0) stays available and is compared with it below.
- **Annual** = `msens::density_annual(n_intervals = 4)` on the DENSITIES — a season NCCOS did not
  model counts as zero — and THEN the same transform. The v8 ingest averaged the transformed values
  over the seasons a cell was *present* in, biasing the annual upward for the sparsest species.
- **Crosswalk** (`data/nc_taxon_crosswalk.csv`, written HERE): common name first, then scientific
  name, then explicit overrides, resolved to the BirdLife `sisid` (the `bl` model table) and the WoRMS
  AphiaID (`spp.duckdb`). `model_nc.csv` carries `sisid`, `worms_id`, `is_guild`, `response_type`;
  `merge_models_prep.qmd` excludes `is_guild` rows.

> **Not yet folded into merge/scoring** (a flagged scoring change, `FOLD_DENSITY`).

## The Atlantic source: `NC_ATL_SOURCE` (`2018` default = control, `2023`)

The Pacific half (Leirness et al. 2021, seasonal) is the same under both. The Atlantic half has two
sources, selected by `NC_ATL_SOURCE`; **the control is `2018`**, which reproduces v10 / the pre-2023
ingest exactly, and **only one Atlantic source is ever ingested in a run** (the 2018 Atlantic models leave
the dataset when `2023` is on).

| | `2018` (default, control) | `2023` |
|---|---|---|
| model | Winship et al. 2018 [@winship2018], OCS Study BOEM 2018-010 | Winship et al. 2023 [@winship2023], OCS Study BOEM 2023-060 |
| product | in-repo COGs `data/sdm/raw/nc_atl_birds_dens/` | MDAT **Avian Relative Density v3.0** (Duke MGEL, April 2024 release) [@curtice2018] |
| species | 47 (140 seasonal models) | 49 (incl. black tern, Forster's tern, lesser black-backed gull; bridled tern dropped) |
| intervals | 4 seasons (+ annual) | 12 months `01`..`12` (+ annual) |
| grid | 2 km, Hotine oblique Mercator | 10 km, Hotine oblique Mercator (NAD83, azimuth 40, centre 75W 35N, k 0.9996) |
| observations | 1978-2016 | 1998-2019 (the files are named `1993_2019`) |
| download | -- | `raw/seamap.env.duke.edu/mdat/v3/` (this notebook downloads it, pins the sha256, records `SOURCE.json`) |

Under `2023`: each species' 12 monthly rasters are reprojected bilinearly to EPSG:4326 and regridded to the
0.05 degree cells exactly as the Pacific COGs are (`cells_from_raster(digits = NULL, min_value = 1e-12)`),
transformed month by month with `density_to_suit("ud")` (cell-area weighted), and the **annual** is OUR
integration of the twelve densities, **day-weighted**: `density_annual(n_intervals = 12, interval = <month>,
weights = msens::month_day_weights())` (msens >= 0.65.1; February counts 28/365), then transformed. The package's own
**delivered Annual** layer is the day-weighted mean of its twelve months (checked here on the native grid to float
precision), so the two should now agree to the regrid's rounding; it is regridded the same way and compared per
species (`data/nc_atl2023_annual_compare.csv`), with the plain 12-month mean kept as a sensitivity (it differs by
up to 8 % in a cell). The Pacific seasons stay equal-weighted (4 seasons, as the 2018 control). The package carries no
"no survey effort" raster: the hatched mask of the MDAT map services is an overlay that is not part of
the download, and every one of the 637 density rasters is strictly positive on the same 13,419 modelled
cells (NaN elsewhere; no zeros, no -9999). The provenance columns `source`, `accession`, `citation` of the
2023 models come from `SOURCE.json`; the front matter above cannot be conditional, so it describes both
sources and `model_nc.csv` / the manifest say which one ran.

**Smoke test (writes nothing to the version's `dist/`).** `NC_SMOKE_DIR=<scratch dir>` redirects the dataset
partition, `model_nc.csv`, the crosswalk and both comparison tables to that directory and skips the
manifest; `NC_TEST_SP=ATPU,BLTE,COMU` (or `NC_TEST_N=<n>`) restricts the regridding to those species.
It refuses a directory inside the big-data root.

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

librarian::shelf(arrow, DBI, dplyr, duckdb, fs, glue, here, jsonlite, logger, purrr, readr, sf, stringr,
                 terra, tibble, tidyr, quiet = T)
library(msens)                      # the installed msens (density_to_suit / density_annual); never via shelf(), which can reinstall a stale main
source(here("libs/paths.R"))
source(here("libs/vars.R"))
source(here("libs/duckdb_budget.R"))
options(readr.show_col_types = FALSE)
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0 || all(is.na(a))) b else a

ds_key   <- "nc"
dir_atlas <- glue("{dir_big_v}/marine-atlas")
dir_dist <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/dataset={ds_key}")
mdl_csv  <- glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/model_{ds_key}.csv")
manifest <- here("data/manifests/ingest_sdm_nc.json")
xw_csv   <- here("data/nc_taxon_crosswalk.csv")
xw_csv_in <- xw_csv                                          # the committed crosswalk is the INPUT registry (new species are appended)
cmp_csv  <- here("data/nc_transform_compare.csv")
acmp_csv <- here("data/nc_atl2023_annual_compare.csv")      # NC_ATL_SOURCE=2023: our annual vs the package's delivered Annual
tmp_nc   <- glue("{dir_big_v}/_tmp/nc")
cog_base <- "https://file.marinesensitivity.org/cog/sdm/raw"
p_cap    <- 0.995                      # the density percentile the OLD recipe used as the 100 point
stopifnot(file_exists(cellid_tif))

# flags (this notebook's own; default = the v11 recipe) ----
nc_transform  <- tolower(Sys.getenv("NC_TRANSFORM", "ud"))        # ud (v11) | cap (the v8 recipe, for comparison)
# nc_atl_source (libs/vars.R, a v11 method flag): Atlantic source, 2018 (Winship 2018, control) | 2023 (MDAT v3, BOEM 2023-060)
stopifnot("NC_TRANSFORM must be 'ud' or 'cap'" = nc_transform %in% c("ud", "cap"),
          "NC_ATL_SOURCE must be '2018' or '2023'" = nc_atl_source %in% c("2018", "2023"))
src_2023 <- nc_atl_source == "2023"

# smoke test: NC_SMOKE_DIR redirects EVERYTHING this notebook writes (dataset partition, model_nc.csv, crosswalk,
# comparison tables, tmp) to a scratch directory and skips the manifest; NC_TEST_SP (codes) / NC_TEST_N restrict
# the regridding to a few species. It never touches the version's dist/ (the guard refuses a path under dir_big).
nc_smoke_dir <- Sys.getenv("NC_SMOKE_DIR", "")
nc_test_sp   <- toupper(str_trim(str_split(Sys.getenv("NC_TEST_SP", ""), ",")[[1]])); nc_test_sp <- nc_test_sp[nzchar(nc_test_sp)]
nc_test_n    <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("NC_TEST_N", "0"))
nc_smoke     <- nzchar(nc_smoke_dir) || length(nc_test_sp) > 0 || nc_test_n > 0
if (nc_smoke) stopifnot("NC_TEST_SP / NC_TEST_N need NC_SMOKE_DIR: a partial ingest must not land in dist/" = nzchar(nc_smoke_dir))
if (nzchar(nc_smoke_dir)) {
  nc_smoke_dir <- path_abs(path_expand(nc_smoke_dir))
  stopifnot("NC_SMOKE_DIR is inside the big-data root" = !str_starts(nc_smoke_dir, as.character(path_abs(path_expand(dir_big)))))
  dir_dist <- glue("{nc_smoke_dir}/dist/dataset={ds_key}")
  mdl_csv  <- glue("{nc_smoke_dir}/dist/model_{ds_key}.csv")
  xw_csv   <- glue("{nc_smoke_dir}/nc_taxon_crosswalk.csv")
  cmp_csv  <- glue("{nc_smoke_dir}/nc_transform_compare.csv")
  acmp_csv <- glue("{nc_smoke_dir}/nc_atl2023_annual_compare.csv")
  tmp_nc   <- glue("{nc_smoke_dir}/_tmp")
  for (d in c("dist", "_tmp")) if (dir_exists(path(nc_smoke_dir, d))) dir_delete(path(nc_smoke_dir, d))   # a smoke run is always from scratch
  dir_create(path_dir(mdl_csv))
} else dir_create(path_dir(manifest))
dir_create(dir_dist); dir_create(tmp_nc)
log_info("nc: transform = {nc_transform}; Atlantic source = {nc_atl_source}; redo = {redo_ingest}; smoke = {nc_smoke}")

if (redo_ingest && dir_exists(dir_dist)) { dir_delete(dir_dist); dir_create(dir_dist) }

# write one model surface as (mdl_key, cell_id, val) parquet. ssn = NA -> annual key/file.
pq_path <- function(safe, ssn) if (is.na(ssn)) glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}.parquet") else
                                              glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}_{ssn}.parquet")
write_parquet_row <- function(d, sid, ssn, safe) {
  mk <- if (is.na(ssn)) glue("{ds_key}|{sid}") else glue("{ds_key}|{sid}|{ssn}")
  msens::write_atlas_parquet(                              # V2/zstd/80MB row groups (Phase A)
    tibble(mdl_key = as.character(mk), cell_id = as.integer(d$cell_id), val = d$val),
    pq_path(safe, ssn))
}
```

## Cell areas

The `ud` transform weights each cell by its area (the population in a cell is density × area). The
`cell` table is a property of the grid, not of the release: this version's `sdm.duckdb` is used when
`build_cell_grid` has written it, else `ver_prev`'s (which `build_cell_grid` copies unchanged).

```{r}
#| label: cell-area

cell_dbs    <- c(sdm_db, glue("{dir_big}/{ver_prev}/sdm.duckdb"))
if (nc_smoke) cell_dbs <- rev(cell_dbs)     # a smoke run reads ver_prev's: this version's sdm.duckdb may be open for writing by a pipeline run
sdm_cell_db <- cell_dbs |> path_expand() |> keep(file_exists) |> first()
stopifnot("no sdm.duckdb with a cell table (this version's or ver_prev's)" = !is.null(sdm_cell_db))
log_info("cell areas from {sdm_cell_db}")
con_sdm <- dbConnect(duckdb(sdm_cell_db, read_only = TRUE))
duckdb_tune(con_sdm, tmp_nc)
ca <- dbGetQuery(con_sdm, "SELECT cell_id, area_km2 FROM cell")
dbDisconnect(con_sdm, shutdown = TRUE)
area_by_id <- rep(NA_real_, 7200 * 3600); area_by_id[ca$cell_id] <- ca$area_km2
# the cell table holds the OCEAN cells only (17.07 M of 25.92 M), while the regridded surfaces fade into
# land cells along the coast (whole range, no land mask): those take the area of their latitude row
# (a cell's area depends on its row alone; the table's rows are constant to 1e-9 relative)
row_of <- \(id) (id - 1L) %/% 7200L + 1L
a_row  <- ca |> mutate(row = row_of(cell_id)) |> group_by(row) |>
  summarise(a = first(area_km2), spread = max(area_km2) / min(area_km2) - 1, .groups = "drop")
stopifnot("cell area is not constant within a row" = max(a_row$spread) < 1e-6)
area_by_row <- rep(NA_real_, 3600); area_by_row[a_row$row] <- a_row$a
cell_area <- function(id) {
  a <- area_by_id[id]; miss <- is.na(a)
  if (any(miss)) a[miss] <- area_by_row[row_of(id[miss])]
  stopifnot("a cell id has no area (no ocean cell in its row)" = !anyNA(a), all(a > 0))
  a }
log_info("cell table: {nrow(ca)} ocean cells, area {round(min(ca$area_km2), 3)}-{round(max(ca$area_km2), 1)} km2; ",
         "land cells take their row's area")
rm(ca)
```

## The 2023 Atlantic package (`NC_ATL_SOURCE=2023`)

MDAT Avian Relative Density **v3.0** (`MDAT_Avian_Relative_Density.zip`, 289 MB; Duke MGEL, distributing the
NCCOS models of Winship et al. 2023). It is **downloaded into `raw/seamap.env.duke.edu/mdat/v3/`** (never read from
a Drive mirror), its **sha256 is pinned here** (the package is rebuilt on the server without a version change:
Last-Modified 2026-06-01 against a 2024-04 release), and `SOURCE.json` beside it records url, sha256, bytes,
Last-Modified, the download date and the cited report. Layout (inspected 2026-10-30): the ZIP unpacks to
`Avian_Relative_Density/commondata/raster_data{N}/{code}_predicted_density_1993_2019_{01..12|annual}.tiff`, one folder per
species (49), 13 single-band Float32 GeoTIFFs each (637), plus the same trees for the CV and 90 % CI
(`Avian_Relative_Density_CV`, `_CI90`; not used) and the ArcGIS map file `esri_mapfile/*.mapx`, which is the only
place the common names are written. All 637 share one grid (176 x 233, 10 km, Hotine oblique Mercator), nodata
`NaN`, 13,419 modelled cells, strictly positive.

```{r}
#| label: mdat-source

mdat_ds   <- "mdat_v3"                                   # the region_ds label of the 2023 Atlantic models
mdat_dir  <- path_expand(glue("{dir_raw}/seamap.env.duke.edu/mdat/v3"))
mdat_urls <- c(zip     = "https://seamap.env.duke.edu/seamap-models-files/mdat/MDAT_Avian_Relative_Density.zip",
               summary = "https://seamap.env.duke.edu/seamap-models-files/mdat/MDAT_Avian_SummaryProducts.zip",
               meta    = "https://seamap.env.duke.edu/models/mdat/Avian/MDAT_Avian_Model_Metadata.pdf",
               changes = "https://seamap.env.duke.edu/models/mdat/Avian/MDAT_Avian_Summary_of_Changes_v3.pdf")
mdat_zip_sha256 <- "5ffb8e3f20c98f30526c5b70d32d4ea711ebdbedbca5aa8bcd98a07fb197f777"   # the package read on 2026-10-30
mdat_root <- path(mdat_dir, "unzipped/relative_density/MDAT_Avian_Relative_Density/Avian_Relative_Density")
mdat_src  <- NULL; mdat_files <- NULL; mdat_sp <- NULL

# download (what is missing), verify the pinned hash, write SOURCE.json once, unzip (the ZIP is kept)
mdat_acquire <- function() {
  dir_create(mdat_dir)
  dest <- path(mdat_dir, path_file(mdat_urls))
  old  <- options(timeout = 3600); on.exit(options(old), add = TRUE)
  for (i in seq_along(mdat_urls)) if (!file_exists(dest[i])) {
    log_info("downloading {mdat_urls[[i]]}")
    download.file(mdat_urls[[i]], dest[i], mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
  }
  sha <- digest::digest(dest[1], algo = "sha256", file = TRUE)
  stopifnot("the MDAT ZIP differs from the package this ingest was written against (sha256) -- re-inspect before ingesting" =
              identical(sha, mdat_zip_sha256))
  sj <- path(mdat_dir, "SOURCE.json")
  if (!file_exists(sj)) {
    lm <- \(u) { h <- curlGetHeaders(u); sub("^[Ll]ast-[Mm]odified: *", "", trimws(grep("^[Ll]ast-[Mm]odified", h, value = TRUE)[1])) }
    files <- imap(mdat_urls, \(u, k) list(url = u, file = path_file(u), sha256 = digest::digest(path(mdat_dir, path_file(u)), algo = "sha256", file = TRUE),
                                          bytes = file_size(path(mdat_dir, path_file(u))) |> as.numeric(), last_modified = lm(u), downloaded = as.character(Sys.Date())))
    write_json(list(url = mdat_urls[["zip"]], sha256 = sha, bytes = as.numeric(file_size(dest[1])), last_modified = lm(mdat_urls[["zip"]]),
                    downloaded = as.character(Sys.Date()), cited_report = "BOEM 2023-060",
                    product = "MDAT Avian Relative Density v3.0 (Duke MGEL; NOAA NCCOS models)",
                    citation = "Winship AJ, Leirness JB, Coyne M, Howell J, Saba VS, Christensen J. 2023. Modeling the distributions of marine birds at sea to inform planning of energy development on the US Atlantic Outer Continental Shelf. Sterling (VA): U.S. Department of the Interior, Bureau of Ocean Energy Management. 413 p. Report No.: OCS Study BOEM 2023-060. https://espis.boem.gov/Final%20Reports/BOEM_2023-060.pdf",
                    accession = NULL, files = unname(files)), sj, auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE, null = "null")
  }
  if (!dir_exists(mdat_root)) {
    log_info("unzipping {dest[1]}")
    unzip(dest[1], exdir = path(mdat_dir, "unzipped/relative_density"))
  }
  stopifnot(dir_exists(mdat_root))
  read_json(sj, simplifyVector = FALSE)
}

# species + files from the package itself: the .mapx layer list carries the common names; the files carry the AOU-style code
mdat_index <- function() {
  lay <- read_json(path(mdat_root, "esri_mapfile/Avian_Relative_Density.mapx"), simplifyVector = FALSE)$layerDefinitions
  idx <- map_dfr(lay, \(l) tibble(name = l$name, file = l$dataConnection$dataset %||% NA_character_)) |> filter(!is.na(file)) |>
    mutate(code = str_extract(file, "^[a-z]+(?=_predicted_density)"), interval = str_extract(file, "[0-9a-z]+(?=\\.tiff$)"),
           common = str_remove(name, ", (January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December|Annual) relative density$"))
  fl  <- dir_ls(path(mdat_root, "commondata"), recurse = TRUE, glob = "*.tiff")
  stopifnot("a basename occurs twice in the package" = !anyDuplicated(path_file(fl)))
  idx <- idx |> mutate(path = fl[match(file, path_file(fl))])
  stopifnot("a layer of the map file has no GeoTIFF" = !anyNA(idx$path),
            "expected 49 species x 13 rasters" = nrow(idx) == 637, n_distinct(idx$code) == 49,
            "each species needs the 12 months and the annual" = all(table(idx$code, idx$interval %in% c(sprintf("%02d", 1:12), "annual"))[, "TRUE"] == 13),
            "one common name per code" = nrow(distinct(idx, code, common)) == 49)
  idx
}

if (src_2023) {
  mdat_src   <- mdat_acquire()
  mdat_files <- mdat_index()
  mdat_sp    <- mdat_files |> distinct(code, common)
  # all 637 rasters share ONE grid, as the regridding below assumes
  sig <- vapply(mdat_files$path, \(f) { r <- terra::rast(f); paste(c(dim(r), terra::res(r), round(as.vector(terra::ext(r)), 3)), collapse = "|") }, "")
  stopifnot("the package's rasters are not on one grid" = n_distinct(sig) == 1)
  log_info("MDAT v3: {nrow(mdat_sp)} species, {nrow(mdat_files)} rasters, grid {sig[[1]]}; sha256 {substr(mdat_src$sha256, 1, 12)}")
}
```

## Models + species crosswalk

```{r}
#| label: models

# normalised name key (letters only, lower case): the AOU codes are defined by common name
norm <- function(x) str_to_lower(str_replace_all(x, "[^A-Za-z]", ""))

# one row per (region, sp_code, season) at band 1 (density)
m <- read_csv(here("data/nc_models.csv")) |>
  filter(var == "n_per_km2") |>
  transmute(region_ds = ds_key, region, sp_code, season, cog_url,
            response_type = if_else(region == "Atlantic", "relative_index", "density"))
stopifnot("unexpected region" = all(m$region %in% c("Atlantic", "Pacific")))

# sp_code -> GBIF id / names, unioned across the two regions' crosswalks
read_xw <- function(f) read_csv(f) |>
  transmute(sp_code, gbif_id = as.character(sp_id), sp_common, sp_scientific)
nc_xw_all <- bind_rows(
  read_xw(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_atl_birds_dens/mw_spp.csv")),
  read_xw(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_pac_birds_dens/m_spp.csv")),
  read_xw(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_pac_birds_dens/m_spp-multiple.csv"))) |>
  distinct(sp_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
nc_multi <- read_csv(here("data/sdm/derived/nc_pac_birds_dens/m_spp-multiple.csv"))$sp_code

if (src_2023) {
  # the 2018 Atlantic models are NOT ingested under 2023 (a species the 2018 set had and 2023 dropped, bridled
  # tern, leaves the dataset; its crosswalk row stays). The 49 species of the package are the Atlantic half.
  m <- m |> filter(region != "Atlantic") |>
    bind_rows(mdat_files |> filter(interval != "annual") |>
                transmute(region_ds = mdat_ds, region = "Atlantic", sp_code = str_to_upper(code), season = interval,
                          cog_url = NA_character_, response_type = "relative_index"))

  # NAME FIRST: the package carries a code and a COMMON name only. A species is the crosswalk's when its common
  # name matches a crosswalk row (and then its code must agree); otherwise it is new and must be curated below,
  # with a scientific name and a GBIF id, which the BirdLife crosswalk chunk then resolves like any other species.
  # (GBIF usageKeys: api.gbif.org/v1/species/match, 2026-10-30, all three EXACT / ACCEPTED species.)
  nc_new <- tribble(
    ~sp_code, ~sp_scientific,      ~gbif_id,
    "BLTE",   "Chlidonias niger",  "GBIF:2481119",     # black tern
    "FOTE",   "Sterna forsteri",   "GBIF:5229247",     # Forster's tern
    "LBBG",   "Larus fuscus",      "GBIF:2481174")     # lesser black-backed gull
  sp23 <- mdat_sp |> transmute(sp_code = str_to_upper(code), mdat_common = common, k = norm(common))
  xw_hit <- sp23 |> left_join(nc_xw_all |> transmute(k = norm(sp_common), hit_code = sp_code, gbif_id, sp_common, sp_scientific), by = "k")
  stopifnot("a MDAT common name matched more than one crosswalk row" = nrow(xw_hit) == nrow(sp23),
            "a MDAT code disagrees with the crosswalk's code for the same common name" = all(is.na(xw_hit$hit_code) | xw_hit$hit_code == xw_hit$sp_code))
  xw_new <- xw_hit |> filter(is.na(hit_code)) |> select(sp_code, mdat_common) |> left_join(nc_new, by = "sp_code")
  stopifnot("a MDAT species is neither in the crosswalk by common name nor curated in nc_new" = !anyNA(xw_new$gbif_id),
            "a 'new' MDAT code is already a crosswalk code under another name" = !any(xw_new$sp_code %in% nc_xw_all$sp_code),
            "nc_new lists a species the crosswalk already resolves" = all(nc_new$sp_code %in% xw_new$sp_code))
  xw_2023 <- bind_rows(
    xw_hit |> filter(!is.na(hit_code)) |> transmute(sp_code, gbif_id, sp_common, sp_scientific, how = "common name (crosswalk)"),
    xw_new |> transmute(sp_code, gbif_id, sp_common = mdat_common, sp_scientific, how = "new species (curated, then BirdLife)"))
  nc_xw <- bind_rows(nc_xw_all |> filter(sp_code %in% m$sp_code[m$region == "Pacific"]), xw_2023 |> select(-how)) |>
    distinct(sp_code, .keep_all = TRUE)
  knitr::kable(xw_2023 |> count(how, name = "n_species"), caption = "2023 Atlantic species by how the crosswalk row was found")
} else nc_xw <- nc_xw_all

stopifnot("a model's sp_code has no species row" = all(m$sp_code %in% nc_xw$sp_code))
nc_xw <- nc_xw |> filter(sp_code %in% m$sp_code) |>
  mutate(is_guild = sp_code %in% nc_multi | str_detect(sp_code, "-") | !str_detect(sp_scientific, " ") |
                    str_detect(sp_common, "spp\\.|/"))
# 2018: 82 codes (47 Atlantic + 46 Pacific - 11 shared), 13 guilds. 2023: 49 Atlantic + 46 Pacific - 11 shared = 84, the same 13 guilds
n_codes_expected <- if (src_2023) 84L else 82L
stopifnot("unexpected number of NCCOS codes / guilds" = nrow(nc_xw) == n_codes_expected, sum(nc_xw$is_guild) == 13)
```

### Crosswalk: common name → scientific name → override, to BirdLife `sisid` and WoRMS AphiaID

The AOU codes are defined by common name, so a common name is the strongest key; the NCCOS scientific
names follow an older taxonomy (`Puffinus gravis` vs *Ardenna gravis*), which is why a name-only match
missed 20 of 79 species and matched three to the WRONG one.

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk

# BirdLife species table (the `bl` model table merge_models_prep.qmd reads its birds from)
bl <- read_csv(glue("{dir_atlas}/dist/model_bl.csv")) |>
  transmute(sisid = as.character(sisid), bl_sci = sci_name, bl_common = common)
bl <- bl |> mutate(k_common = norm(bl_common), k_sci = norm(bl_sci))

# curated overrides (a match the names cannot make)
nc_override <- tribble(
  ~sp_code, ~sisid,     ~note,
  "HERG",   "62030590", "American herring gull = BirdLife Larus smithsonianus (the GBIF name L. argentatus is the European species)")

# common name first; an ambiguous common name is narrowed by scientific name, never guessed
pick_bl <- function(k_common, k_sci) {
  by_common <- bl |> filter(k_common == !!k_common)
  if (nrow(by_common) == 1) return(tibble(sisid = by_common$sisid, match_by = "common name", note = NA_character_))
  if (nrow(by_common) > 1) {
    narrowed <- by_common |> filter(k_sci == !!k_sci)
    if (nrow(narrowed) == 1) return(tibble(sisid = narrowed$sisid, match_by = "common name", note = "common name ambiguous; narrowed by scientific name"))
  }
  by_sci <- bl |> filter(k_sci == !!k_sci)
  if (nrow(by_sci) == 1) return(tibble(sisid = by_sci$sisid, match_by = "scientific name", note = NA_character_))
  tibble(sisid = NA_character_, match_by = NA_character_, note = NA_character_)
}

cw <- nc_xw |> mutate(k_common = norm(sp_common), k_sci = norm(sp_scientific)) |>
  bind_cols(pmap_dfr(list(norm(nc_xw$sp_common), norm(nc_xw$sp_scientific)), pick_bl) |>
              rename(sisid_name = sisid, match_by_name = match_by, note_name = note)) |>
  left_join(nc_override, by = "sp_code") |>
  mutate(sisid    = if_else(is_guild, NA_character_, coalesce(sisid, sisid_name)),
         match_by = case_when(is_guild ~ NA_character_, !is.na(note) & !is.na(sisid) ~ "override",
                              TRUE ~ match_by_name),
         note     = case_when(is_guild ~ sp_common, TRUE ~ coalesce(note, note_name))) |>
  select(-sisid_name, -match_by_name, -note_name, -k_common, -k_sci) |>
  left_join(bl |> select(sisid, bl_sci, bl_common), by = "sisid")

# WoRMS AphiaID by name (BirdLife's accepted name first, then NCCOS's), accepted species of class Aves;
# an unaccepted hit resolves to its accepted AphiaID. WoRMS covers birds poorly, so a miss is a note,
# not a stop: the bird authority is BirdLife (BOTW:{sisid}).
con_spp <- dbConnect(duckdb(path_expand(spp_db), read_only = TRUE))
nm <- unique(na.omit(c(cw$bl_sci, cw$sp_scientific[!cw$is_guild])))
wm <- dbGetQuery(con_spp, glue("
  SELECT scientificName AS nm, CAST(COALESCE(acceptedNameUsageID, taxonID) AS VARCHAR) AS worms_id,
         taxonomicStatus = 'accepted' AS is_acc
  FROM worms WHERE \"class\" = 'Aves' AND taxonRank = 'Species'
    AND scientificName IN ({paste(dbQuoteString(con_spp, nm), collapse = ',')})")) |>
  arrange(desc(is_acc)) |> distinct(nm, .keep_all = TRUE)
dbDisconnect(con_spp, shutdown = TRUE)
cw <- cw |>
  left_join(wm |> transmute(bl_sci = nm, w_bl = worms_id), by = "bl_sci") |>
  left_join(wm |> transmute(sp_scientific = nm, w_nc = worms_id), by = "sp_scientific") |>
  mutate(worms_id = if_else(is_guild, NA_character_, coalesce(w_bl, w_nc))) |> select(-w_bl, -w_nc)

# --- hard stops ----
nong <- cw |> filter(!is_guild)
stopifnot("a non-guild code resolves to nothing" = !anyNA(nong$sisid),
          "two codes resolve to the same BirdLife species" = !anyDuplicated(nong$sisid),
          "two codes share a GBIF id" = !anyDuplicated(nong$gbif_id))
# the three formerly WRONG matches (name-only on GBIF scientific names) must stay impossible:
#  Cory's shearwater -> Calonectris diomedea (Scopoli's, Mediterranean) instead of C. borealis;
#  herring gull -> Larus argentatus (the European species) instead of L. smithsonianus;
#  white-winged scoter -> the European velvet scoter instead of Melanitta deglandi
want <- c(COSH = "Calonectris borealis", HERG = "Larus smithsonianus", WWSC = "Melanitta deglandi")
got  <- setNames(cw$bl_sci[match(names(want), cw$sp_code)], names(want))
stopifnot("the Cory's / herring gull / white-winged scoter crosswalk regressed" = identical(got, want))
# a common-name match must agree with the crosswalk's common name; a name or override match may
# differ only for a curated, known BirdLife rename
common_renamed_ok <- c("DOVE", "PAJA", "HERG")          # Dovekie = Little Auk; Parasitic = Arctic Jaeger; American = Arctic Herring Gull
bad <- nong |> filter(norm(sp_common) != norm(bl_common), !sp_code %in% common_renamed_ok)
stopifnot("a matched species' common name disagrees with the crosswalk" = nrow(bad) == 0)
stopifnot("an override/name match outside the curated list" =
            all(nong$sp_code[nong$match_by != "common name"] %in% common_renamed_ok))

cw_out <- cw |>
  transmute(sp_code, common_name = sp_common, scientific_name = sp_scientific, match_by, worms_id, sisid, is_guild,
            note, gbif_id, sp_id = if_else(is_guild, glue("GUILD:{sp_code}"), gbif_id),
            bl_scientific = bl_sci, bl_common) |>
  arrange(is_guild, sp_code)
# the committed crosswalk is a registry: this run's codes are (re)written, every other code is kept as it is (the 2018 run
# keeps the 2023-only species, the 2023 run keeps bridled tern), so the file does not flip between the two sources
prev_xw <- if (file_exists(xw_csv_in)) read_csv(xw_csv_in, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) else NULL
cw_chr  <- cw_out |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
cw_file <- bind_rows(cw_chr, if (!is.null(prev_xw)) prev_xw |> filter(!sp_code %in% cw_chr$sp_code)) |>
  arrange(is_guild == "TRUE", sp_code)
write_csv(cw_file, xw_csv, na = "")
log_info("crosswalk file: {nrow(cw_file)} codes ({nrow(cw_file) - nrow(cw_chr)} kept from the committed file)")
log_info("crosswalk: {nrow(cw_out)} codes; {sum(cw_out$is_guild)} guilds; WoRMS id for {sum(!is.na(cw_out$worms_id))} of {sum(!cw_out$is_guild)} species")
knitr::kable(cw_out |> mutate(match_by = coalesce(match_by, "guild")) |> count(match_by, name = "n_codes"),
             caption = "crosswalk: codes by match_by")
knitr::kable(cw_out |> filter(!is_guild, match_by != "common name" | scientific_name != bl_scientific) |>
               select(sp_code, common_name, scientific_name, bl_scientific, bl_common, match_by, sisid, worms_id),
             caption = "species whose NCCOS scientific name differs from BirdLife's, or that matched off the common name")
knitr::kable(cw_out |> filter(is_guild) |> select(sp_code, common_name, scientific_name, sp_id),
             caption = "guilds: ingested as nc|GUILD:{code}, excluded from the merge")

# model table with the ingest's sp_id / names
m <- m |> left_join(cw_out |> select(sp_code, sp_id, common_name, nc_scientific = scientific_name, scientific_name = bl_scientific,
                                     is_guild, sisid, worms_id, match_by), by = "sp_code") |>
  mutate(scientific_name = coalesce(scientific_name, nc_scientific))
log_info("nc models: {nrow(m)} (species×season×region); {n_distinct(m$sp_id)} sp_id; guilds: {n_distinct(m$sp_id[m$is_guild])}")
knitr::kable(m |> count(region, season, name = "n") |> pivot_wider(names_from = season, values_from = n))
```

## Regrid + transform

```{r}
#| label: functions

# a source model's density on the 0.05° cells: bilinear reprojection of the omerc COG to EPSG:4326, then
# cells_from_raster() (bilinear onto the cell grid, zero-filled so the surface fades to 0 at its edge).
# digits = NULL: the raster holds NATIVE density, which rounds to 0 at 2 decimals; min_value is a
# positive epsilon, i.e. "any positive density" (the default 1 would drop every cell of a density < 1).
# The 2023 Atlantic rasters (Hotine oblique Mercator, 10 km, NaN nodata) take exactly this path.
src_path <- function(region_ds, sp_code, season) {
  if (region_ds == mdat_ds) mdat_files$path[mdat_files$code == str_to_lower(sp_code) & mdat_files$interval == season]
  else here(glue("data/sdm/raw/{region_ds}/{sp_code}_{season}.tif"))
}
dens_cells <- function(region_ds, sp_code, season) {
  f <- src_path(region_ds, sp_code, season)
  if (length(f) != 1 || !file_exists(f)) return(NULL)
  r <- terra::project(terra::rast(f, lyrs = 1), "EPSG:4326", method = "bilinear")
  msens::cells_from_raster(r, cellid_tif, min_value = 1e-12, digits = NULL) |> rename(dens = val)
}

# intervals per year: 4 seasons, or the 12 months of the 2023 Atlantic package
n_int <- function(region) if (src_2023 && region == "Atlantic") 12L else 4L

# the annual DENSITY of one region's (cell_id, interval, dens) rows: the mean over ALL intervals, an unmodelled one = 0.
# 2023 Atlantic = the DAY-WEIGHTED mean of the 12 months (what the package's own Annual layer is; msens >= 0.65.1);
# the Pacific seasons (and the whole 2018 control) stay equal-weighted, 4 seasons, exactly as before
annual_of <- function(x, region, plain = FALSE) {
  if (src_2023 && region == "Atlantic" && !plain)
    msens::density_annual(x, n_intervals = 12, interval = "interval", weights = msens::month_day_weights())
  else msens::density_annual(x, n_intervals = n_int(region))
}
if (src_2023) stopifnot("NC_ATL_SOURCE=2023 needs msens >= 0.65.1 (density_annual weights / month_day_weights)" =
                          utils::packageVersion("msens") >= "0.65.1")

# density -> [0,100]: the v11 population percentile (ud, area-weighted by the cell table), or the v8
# recipe (cap: linear to the species' pooled p99.5 of positive density, clamped)
to_val <- function(dens, cell_id, how, cap = NA_real_) {
  if (how == "ud") msens::density_to_suit(dens, "ud", area = cell_area(cell_id), digits = 2)
  else             round(100 * pmin(dens / cap, 1), 2)
}

# a species' models in one region as (cell_id, interval, dens)
region_dens <- function(sp_code, region) {
  mi <- m |> filter(sp_code == !!sp_code, region == !!region)
  map2_dfr(mi$region_ds, mi$season, \(rd, s) dens_cells(rd, sp_code, s) |> mutate(interval = s))
}
```

### The annual surface is the mean over ALL intervals of the year

An unmodelled interval counts as zero (NCCOS fits a season only where the species was sighted enough to
model; the 2023 Atlantic package models every species in all twelve months). Checked on the densities, before
any transform, on hand-picked species: with every interval modelled the annual equals the mean of the
intervals (plain for the 4 seasons; DAY-WEIGHTED for the 12 months of the 2023 Atlantic); a species missing a season has a LOWER annual than the
present-only mean (by exactly n_present / 4).

```{r}
#| label: annual-check

chk <- function(code, region) {
  d   <- region_dens(code, region)
  ann <- annual_of(d, region)
  wide <- d |> pivot_wider(names_from = interval, values_from = dens, values_fill = 0)
  list(d = d, ann = ann, wide = wide, n = n_distinct(d$interval))
}
# species modelled in every interval of the year (annual == plain mean of the intervals); under 2023 the Atlantic ones
# carry 12 months, so a species is checked against ITS region's interval count
chk_full <- if (src_2023) list(BFAL = "Pacific", CAAU = "Pacific", ATPU = "Atlantic", COSH = "Atlantic", BLTE = "Atlantic") else
                          list(ATPU = "Atlantic", AUSH = "Atlantic", BFAL = "Pacific", CAAU = "Pacific")
for (code in names(chk_full)) {
  x <- chk(code, chk_full[[code]]); stopifnot(x$n == n_int(chk_full[[code]]))
  weighted <- src_2023 && chk_full[[code]] == "Atlantic"      # the 2023 Atlantic annual is the day-weighted mean of the 12 months
  plain <- if (weighted) {
    w <- msens::month_day_weights(); iv <- setdiff(names(x$wide), "cell_id")
    x$wide |> transmute(cell_id, mean_all = as.vector(as.matrix(x$wide[, names(w)]) %*% w) / sum(w))
  } else x$wide |> transmute(cell_id, mean_all = rowMeans(across(-cell_id)))
  j <- inner_join(x$ann, plain, by = "cell_id")
  stopifnot("annual != the (day-weighted for 2023 Atlantic, else plain) mean over the intervals" = nrow(j) == nrow(x$ann), nrow(j) == nrow(plain),
            max(abs(j$dens - j$mean_all)) < 1e-12 * max(j$mean_all))
}
# species missing an interval (three of four seasons): annual = present-only mean x n_present / n_intervals, always lower
chk3 <- if (src_2023) list(ASSP = "Pacific", BLSP = "Pacific", BVSH = "Pacific") else
                      list(ASSP = "Pacific", BLSP = "Pacific", BVSH = "Pacific", BLKI = "Atlantic")
chk_rows <- list()
for (code in names(chk3)) {
  x <- chk(code, chk3[[code]]); stopifnot(x$n == 3)
  present <- x$d |> group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(present_mean = mean(dens), n_ssn = n(), .groups = "drop")
  j <- inner_join(x$ann, present, by = "cell_id")
  stopifnot("annual is not below the present-only mean" = all(j$dens < j$present_mean),
            "annual != present-only mean x n_present/4" = all(abs(j$dens - j$present_mean * j$n_ssn / 4) < 1e-12 * max(j$present_mean)))
  chk_rows[[code]] <- tibble(sp_code = code, seasons = x$n, cells = nrow(j),
                             mean_annual = mean(j$dens), mean_present_only = mean(j$present_mean))
}
log_info("annual checks passed: {length(chk_full)} species modelled in every interval (annual == plain mean), {length(chk3)} three-season species (annual < present-only mean)")
knitr::kable(bind_rows(chk_rows) |> mutate(across(starts_with("mean"), \(v) signif(v, 3))),
             caption = "three-season species: annual vs the present-only mean the v8 ingest used (cell means)")
```

```{r}
#| label: rasterize

# per sp_id: regrid every (region × season) model, add the per-region annual (density_annual on the
# DENSITIES), transform each model on its own cells (both recipes, for the comparison), write the
# selected one with the regions unioned per season. resumable (skip existing parquet) unless REDO_INGEST.
# SWITCHING THE ATLANTIC SOURCE on an existing dist/dataset=nc. The 2018 and 2023 Atlantic surfaces share files with the
# Pacific ones for the 11 species both oceans model (one parquet per sp_id x interval, regions unioned), and a species whose
# files exist is skipped below, so a dist written under the other source would be resumed INTO the new one. The marker records
# which source the directory holds (none = the 2018 render that predates the switch); when it differs, every species with an
# Atlantic model in EITHER source loses its files and is regridded, Pacific-only species and guilds are kept.
atl_marker <- path(path_dir(mdl_csv), "nc_atl_source.txt")
prev_src   <- if (file_exists(atl_marker)) str_trim(readLines(atl_marker, n = 1)) else "2018"
dist_files <- dir_ls(dir_dist, glob = "*.parquet")
atl_ids    <- character()
if (length(dist_files) && prev_src != nc_atl_source) {
  atl_codes_2018 <- read_csv(here("data/nc_models.csv"), col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |> filter(region == "Atlantic") |> pull(sp_code) |> unique()
  atl_ids <- union(cw_file$sp_id[match(atl_codes_2018, cw_file$sp_code)], m$sp_id[m$region == "Atlantic"])
  if (file_exists(mdl_csv)) atl_ids <- union(atl_ids, read_csv(mdl_csv, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
                                               filter(str_detect(regions, "Atlantic")) |> pull(sp_id))
  atl_ids <- na.omit(atl_ids)
  safes   <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", atl_ids)
  # a file nc_{safe}.parquet or nc_{safe}_{interval}.parquet (the interval has no underscore) belongs to species `safe`
  is_of   <- \(stem, safe) stem == paste0("nc_", safe) ||
    (startsWith(stem, paste0("nc_", safe, "_")) && !grepl("_", substring(stem, nchar(safe) + 5), fixed = TRUE))
  stale   <- dist_files[map_lgl(path_ext_remove(path_file(dist_files)), \(st) any(map_lgl(safes, \(sf) is_of(st, sf))))]
  log_info("Atlantic source {prev_src} -> {nc_atl_source}: removing {length(stale)} of {length(dist_files)} files of the {length(atl_ids)} species with an Atlantic model in either source")
  file_delete(stale)
  left <- dir_ls(dir_dist, glob = "*.parquet")
  stopifnot("a file of an Atlantic species survived the source switch" =
              !any(map_lgl(path_ext_remove(path_file(left)), \(st) any(map_lgl(safes, \(sf) is_of(st, sf))))))
}
writeLines(nc_atl_source, atl_marker)

sp_ids   <- sort(unique(m$sp_id))
if (length(nc_test_sp)) {                                  # smoke test: named codes (NC_TEST_SP) or the first n sp_id (NC_TEST_N)
  stopifnot("NC_TEST_SP names a code that is not an ingested model" = all(nc_test_sp %in% m$sp_code))
  sp_ids <- sort(unique(m$sp_id[m$sp_code %in% nc_test_sp]))
} else if (nc_test_n > 0) sp_ids <- head(sp_ids, nc_test_n)
cmp_rows <- list(); cap_rows <- list(); acmp_rows <- list()

# 2023: our annual (the day-weighted density_annual over the 12 months) against the package's delivered Annual layer, per
# species, plus the plain 12-month mean as a sensitivity (`*_plain`). On the 0.05 degree cells all went through the same
# regrid; `nat_*` check on the NATIVE grid how the delivered Annual is built (plain vs day-weighted mean of the months)
days_in_month <- c(31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31)
annual_compare <- function(code, ours, deliv, plain) {
  stat <- \(a, b) {
    j    <- full_join(a |> select(cell_id, a = dens), b |> select(cell_id, b = dens), by = "cell_id") |>
      mutate(across(c(a, b), \(v) coalesce(v, 0)))
    both <- j |> filter(a > 0, b > 0)
    list(r = cor(j$a, j$b), med = median(both$a / both$b), p05 = quantile(both$a / both$b, .05, names = FALSE),
         p95 = quantile(both$a / both$b, .95, names = FALSE), sum = sum(j$a) / sum(j$b), n_both = nrow(both))
  }
  d <- stat(ours, deliv); p <- stat(plain, deliv)
  nat  <- \(iv) terra::values(terra::rast(src_path(mdat_ds, code, iv)), mat = FALSE)
  M <- vapply(sprintf("%02d", 1:12), nat, numeric(terra::ncell(terra::rast(src_path(mdat_ds, code, "01")))))
  A <- nat("annual"); ok <- !is.na(A)
  pl <- rowMeans(M); dw <- as.vector(M %*% (days_in_month / sum(days_in_month)))
  tibble(sp_code = code, n_cells_ours = nrow(ours), n_cells_deliv = nrow(deliv), n_both = d$n_both,
         r_pearson = d$r, median_ratio = d$med, p05_ratio = d$p05, p95_ratio = d$p95, sum_ratio = d$sum,
         r_pearson_plain = p$r, median_ratio_plain = p$med, p05_ratio_plain = p$p05, p95_ratio_plain = p$p95, sum_ratio_plain = p$sum,
         nat_maxrel_plain = max(abs(A[ok] - pl[ok]) / pl[ok]), nat_maxrel_dayweighted = max(abs(A[ok] - dw[ok]) / dw[ok]))
}

for (sid in sp_ids) {
  mi   <- m |> filter(sp_id == sid)
  safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_", sid)
  done <- all(file_exists(glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}_{unique(mi$season)}.parquet"))) &&
          file_exists(glue("{dir_dist}/{ds_key}_{safe}.parquet"))
  if (done && !redo_ingest) next

  dl   <- pmap(list(mi$region_ds, mi$sp_code, mi$season), dens_cells)
  keep <- !vapply(dl, is.null, logical(1)); mi <- mi[keep, ]; dl <- dl[keep]
  if (!length(dl)) { log_warn("no source rasters for {sid}"); next }
  dd <- map_dfr(seq_along(dl), \(j) dl[[j]] |> mutate(region = mi$region[j], interval = mi$season[j]))
  # the v8 recipe's 100 point: pooled p99.5 of the species' positive densities (all seasons, both regions)
  cap <- as.numeric(quantile(dd$dens, p_cap, names = FALSE))
  if (!is.finite(cap) || cap <= 0) cap <- max(dd$dens)
  # annual per region: mean over ALL intervals of the year (4 seasons; the day-weighted 12 months for the 2023 Atlantic), an unmodelled one = 0
  ann <- dd |> group_by(region) |>
    group_modify(\(x, k) annual_of(x, k$region)) |> ungroup() |> mutate(interval = "annual")
  if (src_2023 && any(mi$region_ds == mdat_ds)) {            # report the delivered Annual layer beside ours (ours is the model)
    code <- mi$sp_code[mi$region_ds == mdat_ds][1]
    dv   <- dens_cells(mdat_ds, code, "annual"); stopifnot("no delivered annual raster" = !is.null(dv))
    plain_atl <- annual_of(dd |> filter(region == "Atlantic"), "Atlantic", plain = TRUE)     # sensitivity: the plain 12-month mean
    acmp_rows[[sid]] <- annual_compare(code, ann |> filter(region == "Atlantic"), dv, plain_atl) |> mutate(sp_id = sid, .before = 1)
  }
  res <- bind_rows(dd, ann) |> group_by(region, interval) |>
    group_modify(\(x, k) tibble(cell_id = x$cell_id, dens = x$dens,
                                v_ud = to_val(x$dens, x$cell_id, "ud"), v_cap = to_val(x$dens, x$cell_id, "cap", cap))) |>
    ungroup() |> mutate(val = if (nc_transform == "ud") v_ud else v_cap)

  # per-model comparison of the two recipes (cells written = val >= 1)
  q <- \(v) quantile(v, c(.1, .5, .9), names = FALSE)
  cmp_rows[[sid]] <- res |> group_by(region, interval) |>
    summarise(n_cells = n(), n_ud = sum(v_ud >= 1), n_cap = sum(v_cap >= 1),
              ud_q10 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[1], ud_q50 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[2], ud_q90 = q(v_ud[v_ud >= 1])[3],
              cap_q10 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[1], cap_q50 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[2], cap_q90 = q(v_cap[v_cap >= 1])[3],
              .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(sp_id = sid, sp_code = mi$sp_code[1], .before = 1)
  cap_rows[[sid]] <- tibble(sp_id = sid, dens_cap = cap)

  # one surface per interval, regions unioned (disjoint; max where they touch)
  for (iv in unique(res$interval)) {
    d <- res |> filter(interval == iv, val >= 1) |> group_by(cell_id) |> summarise(val = max(val), .groups = "drop")
    if (!nrow(d)) next
    write_parquet_row(d, sid, if (iv == "annual") NA_character_ else iv, safe)
  }
}
log_info("rasterized {length(cmp_rows)} sp_id ({nc_transform})")
if (src_2023) {                                             # persisted so a resumed run keeps the rows of the species it skipped
  acmp <- bind_rows(acmp_rows)
  if (file_exists(acmp_csv)) acmp <- bind_rows(acmp, read_csv(acmp_csv) |> filter(!sp_id %in% acmp$sp_id))
  acmp <- acmp |> arrange(sp_code)
  write_csv(acmp |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) signif(v, 6))), acmp_csv)
  off <- acmp$sp_code[abs(acmp$median_ratio - 1) > 1e-3 | acmp$r_pearson < 0.9999]       # the day-weighted annual should now reproduce the delivered one
  if (length(off)) log_warn("our day-weighted annual departs from the delivered Annual (median ratio off by > 1e-3 or r < 0.9999) for: {paste(off, collapse = ', ')}")
  if (any(acmp$nat_maxrel_dayweighted > 1e-5)) log_warn("the delivered Annual is not the day-weighted mean of the months for: {paste(acmp$sp_code[acmp$nat_maxrel_dayweighted > 1e-5], collapse = ', ')}")
}
```

## Model registry (`model_nc.csv`) + transform comparison

```{r}
#| label: model-csv

# stats of every written surface, read back from the parquet (so a resumed run is complete too)
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
duckdb_tune(con, tmp_nc)
surf <- dbGetQuery(con, glue("
  SELECT mdl_key, count(*) AS n_cells, round(min(val), 2) AS val_min, round(max(val), 2) AS val_max
  FROM read_parquet('{dir_dist}/*.parquet') GROUP BY mdl_key"))
dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# every surface in the directory is one of THIS run's models: nothing left over from the other Atlantic source
exp_keys <- c(glue("{ds_key}|{unique(m$sp_id)}"), m |> distinct(sp_id, season) |> transmute(k = glue("{ds_key}|{sp_id}|{season}")) |> pull(k))
stopifnot("dist/dataset=nc holds surfaces that are not this run's models (a stale Atlantic source?)" = length(setdiff(surf$mdl_key, exp_keys)) == 0)

# dens_cap per sp_id: this run's, else the previous registry's (resume)
caps <- bind_rows(cap_rows)
prev_nc <- if (file_exists(mdl_csv)) read_csv(mdl_csv) else tibble()
if ("dens_cap" %in% names(prev_nc))
  caps <- bind_rows(caps, prev_nc |> distinct(sp_id, dens_cap) |> filter(!sp_id %in% caps$sp_id))
meta <- m |> group_by(sp_id) |>
  summarise(sp_code = first(sp_code), common_name = first(common_name), scientific_name = first(scientific_name),
            nc_scientific_name = first(nc_scientific), is_guild = first(is_guild), sisid = first(sisid),
            worms_id = first(worms_id), match_by = first(match_by),
            regions = paste(sort(unique(region)), collapse = "|"),
            response_type = if (n_distinct(response_type) == 1) first(response_type) else "mixed",
            seasons = list(sort(unique(season))), .groups = "drop")
# 2023: the provenance of each region's source (SOURCE.json for the Atlantic package), one entry per region in the order of `regions`
if (src_2023) {
  src_tbl <- tibble(region    = c("Atlantic", "Pacific"),
                    source    = c("MDAT v3 2023-060", "NCCOS Pacific Leirness 2021"),
                    accession = c(mdat_src$accession %||% NA_character_, NA_character_),
                    citation  = c(mdat_src$citation, "Leirness JB et al. 2021. Modeling at-sea density of marine birds to support renewable energy planning on the Pacific outer continental shelf of the contiguous United States. https://repository.library.noaa.gov/view/noaa/49073"))
  # provenance PER SURFACE: a month is the Atlantic package's alone, a season the Pacific's alone, the annual of a species both regions model is both
  src_int <- bind_rows(m |> distinct(sp_id, interval = season, region), m |> distinct(sp_id, region) |> mutate(interval = "annual")) |>
    left_join(src_tbl, by = "region") |> arrange(sp_id, interval, region) |> group_by(sp_id, interval) |>
    summarise(source = paste(source, collapse = "|"), accession = paste(accession, collapse = "|") |> na_if("NA|NA") |> na_if("NA"),
              citation = paste(unique(citation), collapse = " || "), .groups = "drop")
}
# a model row per surface written: the seasonal ones + the annual
model_nc <- meta |> rowwise() |>
  reframe(sp_id, interval = c(seasons, "annual")) |>
  left_join(meta |> select(-seasons), by = "sp_id") |>
  mutate(mdl_key = if_else(interval == "annual", glue("{ds_key}|{sp_id}"), glue("{ds_key}|{sp_id}|{interval}")),
         transform = nc_transform) |>
  left_join(caps, by = "sp_id") |>
  inner_join(surf, by = "mdl_key") |>
  (\(d) if (src_2023) left_join(d, src_int, by = c("sp_id", "interval")) else d)() |>
  (\(d) if (src_2023) mutate(d, atl_source = if_else(str_detect(regions, "Atlantic") & (interval == "annual" | str_detect(interval, "^[0-9]{2}$")),
                                                    "2023", NA_character_)) else d)() |>
  left_join(m |> group_by(sp_id, interval = season) |>
              summarise(cog_url = if (all(is.na(cog_url))) NA_character_ else paste(na.omit(cog_url), collapse = "|"), .groups = "drop"),
            by = c("sp_id", "interval")) |>
  select(mdl_key, interval, sp_id, sp_code, common_name, scientific_name, nc_scientific_name, is_guild, sisid, worms_id,
         match_by, regions, response_type, transform, dens_cap, val_min, val_max, n_cells, cog_url, any_of(c("atl_source", "source", "accession", "citation"))) |>
  arrange(sp_id, interval)
stopifnot("val outside [1,100]" = all(model_nc$val_min >= 1 & model_nc$val_max <= 100),
          "a model has no dens_cap" = !anyNA(model_nc$dens_cap),
          "every guild code must be ingested" = nc_smoke || setequal(model_nc$sp_code[model_nc$is_guild], cw_out$sp_code[cw_out$is_guild]),
          "nc|GUILD key missing" = all(grepl("^nc\\|GUILD:", model_nc$mdl_key[model_nc$is_guild])),
          "every species has an annual surface" = all(table(model_nc$sp_id, model_nc$interval == "annual")[, "TRUE"] == 1))
# 2023 gates: every Atlantic species of the package (the ones processed, under a smoke test) has its 12 monthly surfaces and the
# annual (13 in all, more for the 11 species the Pacific also models), val inside [1,100] and the densest cell of each at 100
if (src_2023) {
  atl_ids <- m |> filter(region == "Atlantic") |> distinct(sp_id) |> pull(sp_id) |> intersect(sp_ids)
  need    <- tidyr::expand_grid(sp_id = atl_ids, interval = c(sprintf("%02d", 1:12), "annual")) |>
    mutate(mdl_key = if_else(interval == "annual", glue("{ds_key}|{sp_id}"), glue("{ds_key}|{sp_id}|{interval}")))
  atl_mod <- model_nc |> filter(mdl_key %in% need$mdl_key)
  stopifnot("a 2023 Atlantic species lacks one of its 12 monthly surfaces or the annual" = all(need$mdl_key %in% model_nc$mdl_key),
            "a 2023 Atlantic surface whose densest cell is not 100" = all(atl_mod$val_max == 100),
            "expected 49 Atlantic species" = nc_smoke || length(atl_ids) == 49,
            "the 2018 Atlantic response type leaked in" = all(atl_mod$response_type %in% c("relative_index", "mixed")))
  log_info("2023 gates: {length(atl_ids)} Atlantic species x 13 surfaces = {nrow(need)} (all present), val_max == 100 for all {nrow(atl_mod)}")
}
write_csv(model_nc, mdl_csv)
log_info("model_nc.csv: {nrow(model_nc)} mdl_keys ({sum(model_nc$interval=='annual')} annual, {n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id)} sp_id, {n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id[model_nc$is_guild])} guilds)")
knitr::kable(model_nc |> count(interval, name = "n"))
knitr::kable(model_nc |> distinct(sp_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |> count(response_type, regions, is_guild, name = "n_sp_id"),
             caption = "sp_id by response type (Atlantic Winship 2018 = relative_index), regions and guild")

# the two recipes side by side, per model (species × region × season|annual); persisted so a resumed
# run keeps the rows of the species it skipped
cmp <- bind_rows(cmp_rows)
if (file_exists(cmp_csv)) cmp <- bind_rows(cmp, read_csv(cmp_csv) |> filter(!sp_id %in% cmp$sp_id))
cmp <- cmp |> arrange(sp_id, region, interval)
write_csv(cmp |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) signif(v, 5))), cmp_csv)
```

```{r}
#| label: compare-transforms
#| results: asis

cat(glue("**{nrow(cmp)} models** (species × region × season, plus annual per region). `n_cells` = cells with a positive ",
         "density; `n_ud` / `n_cap` = cells kept (`val >= 1`) under each recipe; the quantiles are over the kept cells. ",
         "The written surface is `{nc_transform}`.\n\n"))
print(knitr::kable(
  cmp |> mutate(kind = if_else(interval == "annual", "annual", "seasonal")) |> group_by(kind) |>
    summarise(models = n(), across(c(n_cells, n_ud, n_cap, ud_q10, ud_q50, ud_q90, cap_q10, cap_q50, cap_q90), \(v) round(median(v), 1)),
              .groups = "drop"),
  caption = "median over models, by kind"))
cat("\n\n<details><summary>every model, both recipes</summary>\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(cmp |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) round(v, 1)))))
cat("\n\n</details>\n\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: annual-compare
#| results: asis

if (src_2023) cat(glue("### 2023 Atlantic: our annual vs the package's delivered Annual\n\n",
         "**{nrow(acmp)} species.** Our annual (`density_annual` day-weighted by `month_day_weights()`, then the same regrid) is ",
         "the model; the delivered Annual layer is regridded the same way and reported. `median_ratio` is ",
         "ours / delivered over the cells both cover, `sum_ratio` the ratio of totals, `r_pearson` the correlation; the `*_plain` ",
         "columns are the SENSITIVITY: the plain 12-month mean against the same delivered layer. `nat_maxrel_*` is the largest ",
         "relative difference on the NATIVE grid between the delivered Annual and the plain mean of the months / the ",
         "day-weighted mean (the delivered one is day-weighted: February counts 28/365).\n\n"))
if (src_2023) print(knitr::kable(acmp |> select(-sp_id) |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(v) signif(v, 4))), caption = "annual: ours vs delivered"))
cat("\n\n")
```

## Manifest

```{r}
#| label: manifest

# content-addressed, deterministic manifest (Phase A) — no wall-clock, so an identical re-ingest
# produces byte-identical bytes and does NOT invalidate downstream targets. (A smoke test writes none.)
if (nc_smoke) {
  log_info("smoke test: manifest not written; {nrow(model_nc)} models in {dir_dist}")
} else {
  h    <- msens::hash_parquet(glue("{dir_dist}/*.parquet"))
  smry <- arrow::open_dataset(dir_dist) |>
    summarise(n_rows = n(), n_mdl = n_distinct(mdl_key),
              val_min = round(min(val), 2), val_max = round(max(val), 2)) |> collect()
  msens::report_table(smry, caption = glue("nc density model_cell surface (density → population percentile [1,100], {nc_transform})"))

  stats <- list(
    ds_key = ds_key, n_sp_id = n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id), n_mdl = nrow(model_nc),
    n_guild = n_distinct(model_nc$sp_id[model_nc$is_guild]), transform = nc_transform, p_cap = p_cap,
    atl_source = nc_atl_source,
    note = "seasonal + annual density -> population percentile [1,100]; annual = mean over 4 seasons (unmodelled = 0) then transformed; guilds ingested, excluded from the merge; NOT yet folded into merge/scoring")
  if (src_2023) {                                          # which Atlantic package fed the surface (absent under the 2018 control)
    stats$atl_sha256 <- mdat_src$sha256
    stats$atl_report <- mdat_src$cited_report
    stats$note       <- "Pacific seasonal + Atlantic MDAT v3 (BOEM 2023-060) monthly density -> population percentile [1,100]; annual = mean over ALL intervals (4 seasons Pacific, 12 months Atlantic; unmodelled = 0) then transformed; guilds ingested, excluded from the merge; NOT yet folded into merge/scoring"
  }
  msens::write_manifest(manifest, target = "ingest_sdm_nc", content_hash = h, stats = stats,
                        force = msens::force_target("ingest_sdm_nc"))
}
```
